Synopsis:
An advisory article targeting Australian households on how to reduce water heating costs and energy consumption. Key recommendations include efficient showerheads, behavioural changes, modern dishwashers, and — most prominently — heat pump hot water systems as a cost-effective electric alternative to gas. The article highlights available federal and state rebates, the synergy with rooftop solar, and urges proactive planning before existing systems fail.
